title: Rapping, deconstructed: The best rhymers of all time
summary: Vox breaks down how great rappers build rhymes, from Kurtis Blow's simple bars to Biggie's smooth flow and Kendrick Lamar's dense, fast delivery. It uses on-screen visualizations of rhyme structure.
why: HN recommends it as an accessible explanation of rhyme craft that works even for people who aren't hip hop fans.

quote.text: Please consider this required watching, even if you have no interest in hip-hop music
